meta.templateNote: Webhook-triggered by the app's already-built outbound event system (infrastructure/webhooks/outbound-webhook.ts, application/automation/webhook-dispatch.ts) — no app-side code changes needed. Requires an admin to enable the webhook at /admin/automation, paste this workflow's Production URL in, and copy the app-generated signing secret into AVERONAI_WEBHOOK_SHARED_SECRET here. Four events land on this one URL: lead.created_or_updated and lead.status_changed carry { event, companyId, timestamp, data: Lead[] } (bare array); lead.matched and alert.fired carry { event, companyId, timestamp, data: { ruleId, ruleName, [channel, recipient,] leads: Lead[] } } — the two shapes are NOT the same. lead.matched -> real-time Slack ping (already filtered by the alert rule's DB predicate, no n8n-side threshold needed). alert.fired -> WhatsApp copy to an ops/supervisor number (NOT the original recipient, that would double-send) + an append-only Google Sheets audit row. lead.created_or_updated / lead.status_changed are left as deliberate stubs: wiring every lead touch to an external system would duplicate workflow 11's poll-based export and add noise without a clear MVP use case yet — extend them when a real one shows up.
